name: html-ppt
description: HTML PPT Studio — author professional static HTML presentations driven by templates: 36 themes, 31 layouts, 27 CSS + 20 canvas-FX animations, a token-based design system, and a keyboard-navigable presenter mode. Vendored from lewislulu/html-ppt-skill (MIT).
author: Norman

interface.shortDescription: Author professional HTML slide decks from templates.
interface.longDescription: Author professional static HTML presentations as standalone files: 36 themes, 31 layouts, 27 CSS + 20 canvas-FX animations, and a shared token-based design system in assets/base.css. Includes a keyboard-navigable presenter mode (press S) and helper scripts for scaffolding (new-deck.sh) and rendering (render.sh). Vendored from lewislulu/html-ppt-skill under the MIT License.
